description: Lifestyle and habits of the donor.
title: Lifestyle
name: lifestyle

describedBy.description: The URL reference to the schema.

schema_version.description: The version number of the schema in major.minor.patch format.

physical_activity.description: The habitual level of physical activity and regular physical activities.

substance_type.description: Any drug or substance the donor uses or used.
substance_type.example: marijuana; cocaine; heroin; methamphetamine; prescription drugs (non-medical use)
substance_type.guidelines: Should be one of: marijuana; cocaine; heroin; methamphetamine; prescription drugs (non-medical use).

substance_frequency.description: Number of donor's substance usage per year.

substance_use_duration.description: Duration of donor's substance usage in years.

substance_duration_since_last_use.description: If donor is no longer using, specify the number of years since substance usage cessation, if available.
